title: Remnants Of The 5th And 7th Regiments Of The First Marine Division Aboard Transports After Fighting Their Way From Way From Chosin Reservoir, 12/11/1950
summary: National Archives description "Summary: Marine seated on crate opening up package, pulling out other packages which are wrapped with Christmas paper. Pan Shot, of merchant ship standing in harbor, its deck loaded with Marines. LS, tug pushing the transport. Another transport near pier. HS, empty trucks moving in dock area. In the bg, some men in trucks. LS, from shore, ships standing in harbor. HM
